split.test: official is2r/ood_big_no_targets, all 1768; target joined from author energy table

target: Original ODAC23 y_relaxed, full-system relaxed adsorption energy in eV; not per atom or per guest.
source_target_validation: All 166222 available training/development y_relaxed exactly equal the author energy-table values.
input_transforms: Initial positions/cell/atomic numbers only; fixed periodic boundaries
Retain CO2/H2O counts and original atom tags: 0=framework, 1=CO2, 2=H2O
Hash system/source-framework/source-parent identifiers; raw mapping exists only in evidence
Strip source names, sid/fid, initial/total energies, relaxed positions, force and target fields from test
Lossless 15-way gzip JSONL training sharding: each compressed part below 50 MiB; 162224 per-row hashes and complete decompressed-stream hash verified unchanged.
important_limitations: Freezes legacy ODAC23 targets; ODAC25 reports old empty-MOF reference-state artifacts. Not a corrected physical adsorption-energy task.
All sources are public. Hashing IDs does not remove pretraining contamination or structure-based source reidentification.
Source ood_big is based on source framework size; exported supercell atom counts overlap training. No additional atom-count filtering applied.
No shared raw framework, derived pristine-parent ID or exact exported geometry across splits; this is not proof of crystallographic topology uniqueness.
The executed simple median baseline is not a frontier or state-of-the-art result.
